hook: Gurguria ke jungle mein train ruke, to sheesha mat ponchna...
hook_text: Train ki khidki mat saaf karna…
feedback: Solid twist and eerie atmosphere. However, the pacing is a bit slow in the middle: Cuts 7 and 8 repeat imagery without advancing the dread fast enough. Cut 10 has a null line right before the climax—tighten the pacing by combining the realization cuts so the reel stays under 50 seconds. LENGTH: about 68s; it must be 40-52s (roughly 80-104 spoken words). REPEATS: an image is reused too often or twice in a row; use new inserts (hands, eyes, lantern, a clue) instead.
lines: Gurguria ke jungle mein train ruke, to sheesha mat ponchna...
Warna bahar khadi cheez tumhari jagah le legi.
Raat do bajkar pandrah minute par Purulia Express ghane janglon se guzar rahi thi.
S-3 dibbe mein Aniket akela baitha apni beemar behen ki photo dekh raha tha.
Behen ke hospital ke liye usne daftar se bees lakh rupaye churaaye the.
Bahar mat dekhna babu... kohre mein chehra badal jaata hai.
Tabhi achanak bina kisi signal ke train sunsaan jungle mein ruk gayi.
Ghabraahat mein Aniket ka dil tezi se dhadakne laga.
Usne manahi ke bawajood kaampthi ungliyon se khidki ki dhundh ponch di.
Saamne wali seat par wo khud baitha tha... aur uske paise gin raha tha!
Aniket ne neeche dekha, wo train ke bahar barfeele pattharon par khada tha.
Uska roop lekar wo saya uski behen ka ilaaj karaane nikal chuka tha.
Raat mein train rukne par kabhi sheesha mat saaf karna... koi tumhe badal sakta hai.
